description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_TagTransform' which models a transformation of HTML tags, including abstract methods for transforming tags and a concrete method for prepending CSS to style attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_TagTransform
classes.description: An abstract class representing a transformation for obsolete HTML tags into valid ones during purification.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Abstract method to transform an obsolete tag into a valid tag, requiring implementing classes to define the transformation logic.

methods.name: prependCSS
methods.description: Prepend CSS properties to the style attribute of an HTML tag's attribute array, initializing 'style' if it does not exist.
